lines.text: Woe to rebellious children who form an alliance against His will and go to Egypt without asking Him.
Their princes are at Memphis and their envoys have arrived in Hanes, but the people bring neither help nor benefit.
They carry their wealth on donkeys and camels through a land of lions and vipers, and Egypt is called Rahab.
Because they rejected the message, their iniquity will collapse suddenly like a potter's jar, with no shard left.
Repentance and rest would have saved them, but they chose to flee on camels, and a thousand flee at one.
